extras: The plugin makes no network requests; it only reads files picked in the file dialog.
intentEvidence: Import Reddit and Hacker News threads exported by the Comment Scraper browser extension as notes
problem: Users need a way to convert raw exported data from the Comment Scraper extension into structured, navigable notes within Obsidian.

relations.evidence: The export files come from the Comment Scraper browser extension

summary: A tool that imports Reddit and Hacker News threads exported by the Comment Scraper browser extension into Obsidian notes, preserving nested replies and metadata.
